nodes.speaker: Thomas
nodes.text: Papa. What happened? Nobody will tell me anything proper.

nodes.speaker: Thomas
nodes.text: I can see it on your face. Just — just tell me.

choices.text: Sit down, son. I need to tell you something.
Your mother is gone, Thomas. I'm going to find out why.
Go to bed. This isn't your concern.

nodes.speaker: Thomas
nodes.text: I want to help. Whatever you need. I can — I can go places you can't. People don't notice me.
nodes.journal_entry: Thomas wants to help. He's fourteen. But he's right — people don't notice boys.

nodes.speaker: Thomas
nodes.text: I know. I knew when you walked in. Let me come with you, Papa.

nodes.speaker: Edmund
nodes.text: No. You stay here with Rosie.

nodes.speaker: Thomas
nodes.journal_entry: The look on Thomas's face. Clara would have hated that.
